Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

hat — a covering for the head. Example: Her hat is red.
cap — a soft hat with a peak. Example: He is wearing a cap.
glasses — frames with lenses you wear to see. Example: These glasses are new.
watch — a small clock you wear on your wrist. Example: This watch is black.
bag — a container you carry things in. Example: Could I have a bag, please?
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• These glasses are new.
• This watch is black.
• That bag is brown.
• Are these your ...?
• It is my brother's.

Grammar focus: Demonstratives (this/that/these/those).
Use plural forms with glasses: These glasses are new. Use this with singular accessories: this watch, that bag.
